title: Railway RRB Paramedical Categories CEN 05/2026 Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for 590 Post
postName: RRB Paramedical Categories and Other Posts - CEN 05/2026
vacancyDetails: Nursing Superintendent: 365; Dialysis Technician: 01; Health and Malaria Inspector Grade II: 43; Audiologist and Speech Therapist: 01; Pharmacist (Entry Grade): 118; Radiographer X-Ray Technician: 25; ECG Technician: 04; Optometrist: 02; Lab Assistant Grade II: 31.
qualification: Post-wise qualifications include B.Sc Nursing or GNM with Registered Nurse certificate for Nursing Superintendent; B.Sc with Diploma in Haemodialysis or two years satisfactory house training for Dialysis Technician; B.Sc with Chemistry and Health/Sanitary Inspector diploma or NTC certificate for Health and Malaria Inspector; BASLP with RCI registration for Audiologist and Speech Therapist; Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy for Pharmacist; 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry plus Radiography / X-Ray / Radiodiagnosis diploma for Radiographer; relevant ECG or Cardiology qualification for ECG Technician; B.Sc in Optometry or Ophthalmic Technician diploma for Optometrist; and 10+2 Science with DMLT diploma for Lab Assistant.
ageLimit: Age limit is 18-21 years minimum and 30-40 years maximum, post-wise, as on 01/01/2027. Age relaxation applies as per Railway Recruitment Board rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 500/-; SC / ST / PH and all category female candidates: Rs. 250/-. After appearing in Stage I, Rs. 400/- is refundable for General / OBC / EWS candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC / ST / PH and female candidates.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Document Verification → Medical Examination, as prescribed in the detailed CEN.
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, photograph, signature and category or other certificates as applicable; verify the detailed CEN requirements before applying.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open the RRB CEN 05/2026 Paramedical application link when active
3. Register and complete the application
4. Upload documents and pay the applicable fee
5. Submit before the closing date
6. Save the application confirmation
shortDescription: Railway RRB Paramedical Categories CEN 05/2026 Recruitment 2026 for 590 posts. Apply online from 15 September to 14 October 2026.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released the detailed notification for RRB Paramedical Categories Recruitment 2026 under CEN 05/2026 for 590 posts. Eligible candidates can apply online from 15/09/2026 to 14/10/2026.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 15/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 14/10/2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 16/10/2026
  • Correction Window: 17-26 October 2026
  • Examination Date: As per Schedule
  • Admit Card: Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 500/-
  • SC / ST / PH and All Category Female: Rs. 250/-
  • Refund after Stage I: Rs. 400/- for General / OBC / EWS and Rs. 250/- for SC / ST / PH / Female candidates

Vacancy Details: Total 590 Posts

  • Nursing Superintendent: 365
  • Dialysis Technician: 01
  • Health and Malaria Inspector Grade II: 43
  • Audiologist and Speech Therapist: 01
  • Pharmacist (Entry Grade): 118
  • Radiographer X-Ray Technician: 25
  • ECG Technician: 04
  • Optometrist: 02
  • Lab Assistant Grade II: 31

How to Apply

Visit the official RRB application portal, select CEN 05/2026, complete the registration and application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee and submit the form before 14 October 2026. Read the official notification for post-wise age, qualification and selection details.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are announced in RRB CEN 05/2026 Paramedical recruitment?
faqs.answer: The detailed CEN 05/2026 notification lists 590 vacancies across the notified paramedical categories.

faqs.question: When will the RRB Paramedical CEN 05/2026 application start?
faqs.answer: The online application starts on 15 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply online is 14 October 2026. The last date for fee payment is 16 October 2026.

faqs.question: Where can candidates apply for RRB Paramedical CEN 05/2026?
faqs.answer: Applications will be submitted online through the official RRB application portal at rrbapply.gov.in.
